controls.name: txtCountry
controls.toolTip: Enter the Country. Press F2 or Double Click for Help
controls.usage: Stores Country Name. Tag stores CountryCode.

controls.name: txtCity
controls.toolTip: Enter the City. Press F2 or Double Click for Help
controls.usage: Stores City Name. Tag stores CityCode (which maps to CountryCode in DB with ParentCode > 0).

controls.name: txtCode
controls.usage: Not actively used for saving, just defined in UI.

dataBindings.query: Select CountryName,CountryCode From COM_CountryCity_Master where ParentCode=0
Select CountryName,CountryCode From COM_CountryCity_Master where ParentCode=Val(txtCountry.Tag)

events.name: CmdClear_Click
events.description: Clears form inputs and resets states.

events.name: cmbType_Click
events.description: Toggles visibility and enabled states of txtCity and txtCountry based on selected type.

events.name: cmdSave_Click
events.description: Validates, checks duplicates, starts transaction, executes SP for insert/update, and commits.

events.name: txtCountry_DblClick
events.description: Opens lookup to select existing country.

events.name: txtCity_DblClick
events.description: Opens lookup to select existing city under the selected country.

events.name: CheckSave
events.description: Enables/Disables save button based on input states.

procedures.name: ValidateData
procedures.description: Checks if required fields are filled based on cmbType selection.

databaseOperations.description: Get new CountryCode on insert. (Note: Only used for fetching snap('CountryCode') to pass to SP)

businessRules.name: Type Toggle Logic
businessRules.description: If cmbType is 'Country', txtCity is disabled and cleared. If 'City', txtCity is enabled. txtCountry is locked if 'City', but wait, the logic says if 'Country', txtCountry.Locked = False, if 'City', lblCity.Enabled = True, txtCity.Enabled = True, txtCountry.Locked = True.

businessRules.name: City Creation Dependency
businessRules.description: Cannot create a City unless a Country is already selected (Val(txtCountry.Tag) > 0).

validations.message: Enter the Country Name (or City Name based on type)

conditions.result: Considered an Update operation if Country Type, else if City Type requires both Val(txtCountry.Tag)>0 and Val(txtCity.Tag)>0 to be an Update.

messages: You can create City only for already created Country
